basics.name: Cláudio Paulo
basics.label: Backend Software Engineer
basics.summary: Backend software engineer with 8+ years building APIs and microservices for telecom, banking and SaaS, from SMS platforms processing 1M+ daily transactions to banking applications used by 4M+ customers. Java/Spring Boot, Python, Node.js and Rust, deployed with Docker, Kubernetes and Azure. Founder of K2ACPTech, a freelance software consultancy.

work.name: K2ACPTech
highlights: Hospital pathology system (Angola): replaced manual workarounds that could leave the laboratory stalled for days or weeks when connectivity failed. Built an offline-first desktop application (Rust, Tauri, local SQLite) with a Fastify API and PostgreSQL, handling 1,000+ lab reports per day with real-time data and statistics. Delivered and integrated in six months (Feb–Aug 2025).

Pharmacy website (Canada): customers can place orders, make bookings and appointments, submit prescriptions and see when a prescription is ready for pickup. Designed and launched the site with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS and Supabase.

HR administration panel: manages 125+ employees and automates time clocking, vacations, absences, business travel, salaries, recruitment and work schedules. Built with React, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL.
Across freelance projects: implemented CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments (Docker and Kubernetes) to automate releases.

work.name: TIMWETECH (formerly TIMWE Group)
work.summary: Consultant via Adentis until June 2022, then employed directly by the company.
highlights: Architected a microservices infrastructure using Java, Python, RabbitMQ and Docker.

Designed the architecture (approved by the team architect) and built an automated, end-to-end encrypted file processing system (Java/Python) that decrypts, parses and ingests client files of 1 GB+ (some in the terabytes), generated every 5 to 20 minutes, streaming real-time events via RabbitMQ.

Replaced long manual investigations (once a full day) with one-click recovery: built a custom Django operational dashboard and active thread monitoring service to track file delivery and to retry, re-process, resend or update encryption keys.
Gave the team and clients real-time visibility into the status of events and file processing through Grafana monitoring and alerting.
